bi-.definition:
In most branches of science bi- in composition denotes two,
   twice, or doubly; as, bidentate, two-toothed; biternate, doubly
   ternate, etc.
 In the composition of chemical names bi- denotes two atoms,
   parts, or equivalents of that constituent to the name of which it is
   prefixed, to one of the other component, or that such constituent is
   present in double the ordinary proportion; as, bichromate, bisulphide.
   Be- and di- are often used interchangeably.
bi-.translation:
pref. 二(倍), 复, 重, 双, 两
[医] 二, 两, 双

bi-coastal.translation: adj. （活跃在）大西洋和太平洋东西海岸的

bi-cultural.translation: adj. 二元文化的；两种不同文化混合的

bi-focal.translation:
a. 双焦的；双焦点的
n. 双光眼镜；双重焦点透镜

bi-focals.translation:
(bi-focal 的复数) adj. 双焦的；双焦点的
n. 双光眼镜；双重焦点透镜

bi-fuel propellant.translation: [机] 二元燃料组成的火箭推进剂

bi-grams.translation: (bi-gram 的复数) 双词同现频度

bi-level.translation:
n. 双层物

bi-lingual.translation:
adj. 双语的

bi-national.translation: adj. 两个民族的；两个国家的；由两个国家（或民族）组成的

bi-partisan.translation: adj. 两党连立的；代表两党的

bi-plane.translation: n. 复翼飞机, 双翼飞机

bi-planes.translation: (bi-plane 的复数) n. 复翼飞机, 双翼飞机

bi-racial.translation: adj. 二种人种的（（尤指黑、白人种的）

bi-sexual.translation: adj. 两性的；雌雄同体的

bi-weekly.translation:

bi-wiring.translation: 双线分音（用两条线连接扩音器和扬声器以提高音质）
